findings.summary: Freshness check uses a clock value captured before the sample is read, so a sample written in the interval gives negative age and cancels a healthy run.
findings.failure_scenario: now=clock() at line 189; _lease_check and ps subprocess (line 197, up to 0.5 s) run; sampler writes a sample at monotonic > now; latest_resource_sample(now=now) computes age < 0 and require(0.0 <= age) at line 56 raises; loop cancels with resource_monitor_failure and final status is failed_postflight_or_publication.

findings.summary: Sampler error before the first complete sample leaves the MPS cap unenforced for the whole run because a missing sample is treated as zero.
findings.failure_scenario: _sample raises before its first write (worker.py:425-426 only records the error); every poll gets sample None and mps=0 (supervisor.py:199); the run continues past 6 GiB MPS until the 590 s deadline. Only postflight 'No resource samples retained' fails the final status.

findings.summary: Partial-only resource log raises while an empty log returns None, so startup handling is inconsistent.
findings.failure_scenario: The first sample line is caught mid-write with no newline; complete is empty after the partial-tail pop and require at line 49 raises, cancelling the run at startup instead of treating it as no sample yet.

findings.summary: Postflight parses the resource log with read_text().splitlines() and json.loads, not the partial-tail-tolerant reader, contradicting the R3 claim.
findings.failure_scenario: A sampler write cut short by SIGTERM or SIGKILL from stop_owned_child leaves a partial last line; json.loads raises at line 249 and the result records postflight_error instead of ignoring the tail.

findings.summary: Process-group cleanup signals only while the direct child is still running, so surviving group members are left alive when the leader has exited.
findings.failure_scenario: The worker leader exits while a group member still holds RSS or MPS; poll() is not None so killpg is skipped at lines 78 and 90 and the else branch at 214 is taken; group_absent_after_reap is False, the status fails closed, but the member keeps running.
